lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₁₄Zn crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula Mg₂₈Zn₂ and 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg and Zn centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; the Mg–Mg and Mg–Zn distances span roughly 3.03–3.25 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 30 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate that Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces in several observed relations.
